sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their impressive form. Sandbach are firmly in control atop the table with 22 points from 10 games and a recent sequence of five wins and one draw, while visitors Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a direct battle between top-four sides, with both teams having won their last matches. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face a visiting Wednesfield Community side searching for consistency. Bilston Town (sixth) are at home to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter on an alarming run of five consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a contest between sides in the lower half, Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle of struggling teams near the bottom, Crewe host Allscott Heath with both sides dealing with form issues, and Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, who remain pointless after seven games and are in dire straits.
